notes.title: Cartography Update
notes.content:
Hey! 

Never get lost again with Cartography (tm)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32151615/1869904ea16a3a3a4be68ee12139782194d88119.png[/img]


Here's the changelog for version 1.0.6 :

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Cartography research
[*] Added map UI and map item
[*] Salazar gives paper to players who have none now
[/list]


[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Wailroot spawn and acid times decreased by half
[*] Wailroot acid damage doubled
[*] Made Esoteric Optics unlock by completing 100% of alchemy research on an object
[*] Alchemy clue scrolls now give 30% less points
[*] Researching 100% alchemical research of an object now grants bonus points
[*] Reduced Warniak aggro range by 50%
[*] Reduced drunk effect time from Laudanum by 30%
[*] Cut health regeneration of bandages by 50%
[*] Decreased warniak speed by 6.6%
[/list]


[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed no sound found null exception
[*] Fixed atamur projectile crashing the game via damage tooltips
[*] Fixed elemental fury save error
[*] Fixed void sphere damage type
[*] Fixed Zun wizard map null reference
[*] Fixed wrong font on recipe titles
[*] Fixed sound parameters not being set correctly
[*] Fixed zun mage research point option disappearing even after not being clicked on
[*] Optimized quest indicator lag
[*] Ritual knife can no longer be studied in alchemical lab
[*] Fixed incorrect space tutorial UI positioning
[*] Fixed signal UI overlaying research book UI
[*] Physical conditioning additional health now saves properly
[*] Fixed item visual effects persisting on swap action
[*] Fixed a null exception occurring while exiting tent/world while potion creation animation is playing
[*] Laudanum drunk forever
[*] Fixed sounds being too laud in the bog
[*] Fixed Warniaks chasing forever
[*] Fixed cauldron splash not playing
[*] Fixed Warniak spawners not obeying spawn limit
[/list]

[h1]Next Update Plan[/h1]

[list]
[*] Pinnable UI to show recipe requirements
[*] Salazar as a companion
[*] Make Fang fauna and flora harvestable for new ingredients
[*] Elemental spells
[*] Mac version
[*] New optional areas with rewards that require certain potions/spells
[*] New weather and combat events
[/list]

Bugs that are not fixed yet (but I'm aware of them and working to get them):
[list]
[*] Enchantment trigger persists in an area after enchanting
[*] You can research research papers in alchemy lab (researchception)
[/list]

Steam cloud saves have been disabled as they wiped some of your saves clean unfortunately, will look to implement cloud saves differently in the future. 

If you'd like to vote what changes should be a priority for Artificer join in our Discord and let me know!

Thanks for all the support, all the best!

Peter

notes.title: The Krondir Update!
notes.content:
Hello there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32151615/590d050898c7778c272196fef566495e5cf3fba7.png[/img]

Here's the changelog for this major update, enjoy!

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added global settings in main menu
[*] Added close buttons to tutorials
[*] Added new monster - Krondir, corpse, autopsy research and conarium item
[*] Added Krondir meadows with rare resources to world generation
[*] Plant life should now respawn after some time
[*] Added Physical Conditioning research
[*] Added map leading to the Zun wizard
[*] Added recycling recipes for iron tools and chimer armor
[*] Added four elemental weapon enchantments
[*] Added research - Primordial Prismatics
[*] Added hidden elemental weapon enchantment
[*] Added protection amulet enchantment
[*] Autopsies now grant additional damage against creatures
[*] Added new sounds for wailworm
[*] Added new regeneration animation for Ossimians
[*] Added hint about Ossimian fire weakness
[*] Added new Ossimian sounds
[*] Added new Trag sounds
[*] Added new Eye Of Moloch sounds
[*] Added new Mogg warrior sounds
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved world backup to quit to desktop/quit to menu
[*] Mogg Warriors now drop coins on death
[*] Wailworm speed increased by 15%
[*] Wailworm attack cooldown decreased by 30%
[*] Reduced the range of sword from 4 to 3
[*] Reduced sword knockback from 0.3 to 0.2 
[*] Reduced spear knockback from 0.9 to 0.7
[*] Reduced the range of spear from 5 to 4
[*] Reduced Ossimian HP from 8 to 5
[*] Increased Ossimian damage by 0.1
[*] Increased Algae Bandage healing speed by 0.1
[*] Increased Algae Bandage healing duration by 0.5
[*] Reduced Chimer armor rating by 0.3
[*] Increased stone spear damage by 0.1
[*] Increased iron sword damage by 0.3
[*] Reduced Trag attack cooldown by 0.5
[*] Reduced Trag hp by 0.6
[*] Added poison damage to Trag attack
[*] Added acid vulnerability to Trag
[*] Reduced Trag knockback by 0.7
[*] Eye of Moloch knockback increased by 0.1
[*] Increased Eye of Moloch damage by 0.5
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Thaumaturgic book not received when exitting dialogue with escape
[*] Fixed message bar being cut off on non 16:9 resolutions
[*] Fixed kiln fire flickering while moving
[*] Fixed attack colliders
[*] Fixed space tutorial appearing in dialogue
[*] Fixed WSAD not unbinding
[*] Fixed tutorial UI layers
[*] Removed visible ground from Thabit interior
[*] Fixed a bug that made the game load the wrong save after ending
[*] Fixed moloch's brain being consumed in alchemical research
[*] Fixed cursed wailroots being consumed in alchemical research
[*] Fixed cursed wailroots being consumed in alchemical research
[*] Fixed snakeweed not being snakey enough
[*] Fixed pyrethrin shader
[*] Fixed death sounds not playing properly
[*] Fixed knockback modifiers not working properly
[*] Fixed infinite armor on swap exploit
[/list]

[h1]Way forward[/h1]

The combat balance changes require your feedback. Adding more hp to the player and increasing his movement speed with Physical Conditioning research changes a lot so I'll keep adjusting so the discovered items feel more relevant and monsters don't feel too weak. 

Some things that I really wanted in this update did not make the cut. I need some more time to work on them and you can expect them to drop in January. Here's the list:

[list]
[*] Salazar passive resource gathering after giving him courage
[*] More random combat encounters
[*] More magical loot from certain enemies
[*] More useful items from the trader
[*] Further balance of endgame monsters (Guardian and Tasoth mostly)
[*] Button to regenerate world
[/list]

More long term goals:

[list]
[*] Add a new end game boss creature (the art is done, just misses the AI)
[*] Add teleportation spell, and more elemental spells
[*] Add mana potions and rebalance spellcasting so it's actually useful

[/list]

I'll keep working on the game for you, also look at [url=https://discord.gg/BuyW8vU]Psilocybe Discord[/url] for a big announcement in January.

Have a safe, healthy, merry and awesome Christmas!

All the best

Psilocybe Team

notes.title: Artificer is ready to play!
notes.content:
[h1]Delve into the arcane secrets of Alcor[/h1]

[previewyoutube=yFL1PKQnvsw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Study the arcane of magic[/h1]

Alcor is an alien planet, full of deadly creatures, bizarre plants, and inhabited by alien races. You were on the mission to examine this mysterious planet, but your starship crashed. 

Now you are on your own in a hostile environment. All you have is your resourcefulness and intellect against the eldritch beings of Alcor. 

Soon you will discover you'll need more than just your intellect to survive. You will need [b]magic[/b]

[list]
[*] Study the arcane of magic,
[*] discover alchemy, thaumaturgy,
[*] steal arcane secrets from ancient ruins,
[*] learn alien languages to read magical grimoires,
[*] perform magic rituals,
[*] gain unlimited power,
[*] and escape the Alcor!
[/list]

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone,[/h1]

[h2]We have decided to move the release of the Artificer. The game launch will be [b]this September[/b]. [/h2]

We are sorry everyone waiting for today's release. This last-minute decision wasn't the easiest but we believe it is the right one.

As the publisher, we are responsible for giving the players games of the highest quality.  The game we received didn't match our expectations. The core mechanics -(magic, and crafting) are all there, but to make your experience enjoyable we need this additional time to polish and balance the game.  

If you want to help the developers, sign-up for closed beta tests.
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScx2uQS5AOKn7CEuCTNsLtncnMqGDCi2Ry2Q-ltMhFqW6C_qg/viewform?usp=sf_link][b]Sign-up here.[/b][/url]
The keys will be sent every week to the chosen players.

notes.title: Artificer Science Of Magic Quick Pitch
notes.content:
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/igttUgHDXmc8wZV9xb/giphy.gif[/img]

Have you ever wanted a game where you discover magical secrets through experimentation? 
Here comes Artificer - the story of a space engineer stranded on a planet ruled by the arcane. 

RPG-like progression is made by studying alien flora and fauna, experimenting with alchemical reagents and examining enchanted items. 

The game has over 30 technologies in 3 science trees, hundreds of items, a plethora of monsters to dissect and dangers to overcome, along with 7 different science minigames. 

Brew your magical elixirs, enchant your weapons and mutate yourself to survive!

Coming to Steam mid July.

[*] Fixed numerous minor bugs

All the best!

Psilocybe Team

notes.title: Important news!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32151615/8922b8d1ccbf731958ad7a39131a0c783f4f0d6c.png[/img]

You've probably seen the release date rescheduled to 2019 and thought to yourself WTF Psilocybe?!

Well here's the explanation. We've struck a deal with a publisher - Games Operators that will enable us to expand the team and work on the game for nearly a year. That means we'll probably dodge Early Access entirely. This is an amazing opportunity for both the studio and the game and we're dancing with joy right now. 


We'll be able to bring more magic (both literally and figuratively) to Artificer and polish it to fully realize the vision we had for the game. 

The Early Access process of development will be redirected to our Discord community and Patreon where you'll be able to access the early builds and be part of the creation process.

Thanks to all of you who added Artificer to your wishlist, it is partly thanks to you that we got the deal in the first place. 

I'll be back with more news on the expansion of our studio and planned content. 

Yours

Peter
